notes.title: Monster Jaunt v1.1 - New minigames!
notes.content:
A lot of folks have been searching for great multiplayer games to play online with friends lately, so I thought I'd chip in a few more minigames for Monster Jaunt. These new minigames were designed with Remote Play Together in mind, in addition to the existing minigames which already largely work great online.

(the text box for inputting this description is very large but that's all I had to say. stay safe!)
